# Lab 7.17: IAM vs ACLs on Cloud Storage

## What We Are Going to Do
Compare fine-grained ACLs with uniform bucket-level access, and see why uniform access is the recommended choice.

## Steps

1. **Create a bucket with fine-grained access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab \
  --location=us-central1 \
  --no-uniform-bucket-level-access
echo "secret" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab/file.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Add an object ACL.** This gives Alice access to one object, which IAM does not show.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage objects update gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab/file.txt \
  --add-acl-grant=entity=user-alice@YOUR_DOMAIN,role=READER

gcloud storage objects describe gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab/file.txt --format="yaml(acl)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **See the problem.** Open the bucket's **Permissions** tab. The IAM list does not show Alice. Access is now split between two systems.

4. **Switch to uniform bucket-level access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab --uniform-bucket-level-access</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   ACLs stop working immediately. Alice can no longer read the file.

5. **Grant access the IAM way.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Enforce it everywhere.** In **Organization policies**, enforce **Enforce uniform bucket-level access** on the project.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-acl-lab</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| ACLs | Per object, hard to audit |
| Uniform access | IAM only, one place to check |
| Reverting | Possible for 90 days after enabling |
| Org policy | Makes uniform access the rule |
